We need to decide relation between two yes/no questions.

Q1: "Should animal welfare be considered an essential component of sustainability in animal food production?" This is a normative question about whether animal welfare should be considered essential component of sustainability.

Q2: "Should Brazil adopt measures to comply with the UNEP Nexus Resolution on animal welfare, environment and sustainable development?" This asks about Brazil adopting measures to comply with a specific resolution.

These are different questions: one is about conceptual inclusion of animal welfare in sustainability; the other about a specific policy action by Brazil regarding a specific resolution. Even if related, answering yes to one does not determine answer to other. So DIFFERENT.
